title: 雑貨店で、小さな星を見つけた

visual_review.identity: B-like grey eye zones, soft smile, bob and one plain silver pin retained; face is large enough to read clearly.
visual_review.outfit: White rounded collar and puff blouse, lemon bow, ruffled blue/white gingham bodice and skirt retained. Socks and shoes are outside the intended crop.
visual_review.action: Star keychain and attached ring rest in the open palm. Other hand rests on the counter; no obvious extra limb or prop fusion.
visual_review.story: One white paper bag with aqua loop handles stands at the counter. Star purchase starts the series.
limitations: Shelf stock and gingham scale are illustrative variations; not exact product-design reproduction.

acceptance.scope: Accept the presented C02, C03 and C04 weekend-walk scenes for repository preservation.

path_base: Image and prompt paths are relative to the parent weekend-walk directory.
